Outcome_variable.evidence_source: [/page/15/Text/6] To index change in SWB configuration, a trichotomous variable was created in which each participant's Time 2 SWB configurations was compared to their Time 1 SWB configuration and participants changing toward a high SWB configuration or any intervening configuration (e.g., change from cluster 3 to cluster 2 over time) were assigned a positive value (?1, n = 136), participants not changing configurations over time (i.e., stable SWB configuration over time) were assigned values of zero (n = 178), and participants changing toward a low SWB configuration or any intervening configuration (e.g., change from cluster 3 to cluster 4) were assigned a negative value (-1, n = 132).[/page/15/Text/7] As shown in Table 8, higher (residual) levels of psychological and interpersonal functioning at Time 2 were uniquely predicted by membership at Time 1 in cluster 1 (high SWB), cluster 2 (low affect), and cluster 3 (high NA) versus cluster 5 (low SWB), as well as by positive change over time in SWB configuration, that is, change toward a high SWB configuration. In addition, higher levels of physical functioning at Time 2 were uniquely predicted by membership at Time 1 in cluster 1 (high SWB) versus cluster 5 (low SWB) as well as by positive change in SWB configuration. In each model, the unique effect of Time 1 membership in cluster 4 (low LS) versus cluster 5 (low SWB) was non-significant.
